properties.name: manual-work
properties.purpose:
The work a session did BY HAND that reflow2 already serves — the negative space. Records one piece of hand-rolled work with a closed-set diagnosis (`tool_missing` / `tool_not_found` / `tool_refused` / `unknown`) and reads the collection back, so a MISSING tool is distinguishable from an UNFINDABLE one. Implemented in `crates/reflow2-core/src/manual_work.rs`; the record is written as a TemporalFact, stays local, and must never be lifted into telemetry (`req:telemetry-carries-usage-never-design-content`).

GIVEN A PART OF ITS OWN on Anthony's word 2026-08-26, under the ruling recorded as `chg:allocation-follows-the-code-not-the-neighbour` (2026-08-25, 'move it, do not dual-allocate'): the module is real, checksummed and linked by `art:manual-work`, so the cheap alternative — crediting the function to `cmp:temporal` next door because both write TemporalFacts — is precisely the misfiling class that change spent a session correcting in 19 places. Allocating instead to `cmp:tools-temporal`, where `report_manual_work` and `manual_work_report` are declared, was rejected against `dec:the-tool-surface-slices-hold-no-function-of-their-own`. Filing it by PURPOSE under `sub:session-posture` was also offered and declined: that is the by-purpose habit the same ruling corrects against, and it would split a core module from its siblings in core.
